notes: Two-stage: build a triage program, then run it on the fixtures to emit alert.json and report.json. Reasoning: rule firing vs statistics (all rules reported, only firing ones alerted), dedup+sort of ips, deterministic event scan order. Adversarial: hidden rule sets probe missing/non-string patterns, invalid regexes, defaulted thresholds/severities, threshold 0 always firing, non-object rules, an invalid-JSON rules file yielding empty structures, and empty logs. Quantitative: exact match counts and schema keys.
